subject: Partner-led discovery: CloudBridge marketplace integration - next steps
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Samir Khatri <samir@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Asha Rao <asha@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Partner-led discovery: CloudBridge marketplace integration - next steps

Hi all — great conversation earlier. Quick recap from my side and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

- Goal: Confirm technical feasibility for a CloudBridge marketplace listing and schedule a technical deep dive / demo for CloudBridge engineering.
- Key requirements surfaced: marketplace connector for provisioning, SSO/JIT user mapping, and a baked-in billing attribution flow (CloudBridge needs per-customer usage metering).

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical deep dive with Redwood SE + CloudBridge eng (45–60m) — cover auth, provisioning, and billing/webhook flows.
2) Demo of Redwood Dedicated & Private onboarding flow for marketplace listing (30m).

Suggested slots (PST):
- Tue 13 Apr 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed 14 Apr 09:00–10:00 or 15:00–16:00

Samir / Asha — can you confirm which slot works, or share preferred times? Marissa / Dev / Mateo — please confirm availability and any other folks we should include (PM/support/ops).

I attached a short draft agenda for the demo (demo-agenda.docx) and included a lightweight infra checklist for the deep dive.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Partner Manager, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: demo-agenda.docx (docx, 14KB), infra-checklist.txt (text, 3KB)

From: Samir Khatri <samir@cloudbridge.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner-led discovery: CloudBridge marketplace integration - next steps

Thanks Camila — appreciate the recap. CloudBridge is excited to move forward. 

We can do Tue 13 Apr 14:00–15:00 PST (works best for our eng + PM). If anything changes, I’ll update. For the deep dive please include someone who owns the provisioning API and the billing/export interfaces.

Quick note: we have a short internal doc on our marketplace Partner Integration Requirements — I’ll attach the short MAP summary and share a calendar invite once we lock the time.

Samir Khatri
Head of Platform Partnerships
CloudBridge
samir@cloudbridge.com

Great — thanks Samir, Camila. 14:00–15:00 PST on Tue 13 Apr works for me. I’ll be present on the call to run the commercial framing and next-step checklist. 

Agenda suggestion (brief):
- 5m: Intros & goals
- 15m: Marketplace integration requirements (CloudBridge leads)
- 20m: Redwood technical walkthrough (Dev + Mateo) — provisioning & SSO patterns
- 10m: Billing attribution & webhooks
- 10m: Actions & timeline

I’m attaching a proposed demo agenda (demo-agenda.docx) for your review. Also, Dev — can you confirm if we need customer-specific test accounts or any firewall/NAT details before the deep dive?

Thanks — I’ll wait for the calendar invite and will add our GSI contact if needed.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solution Sales, Redwood Inference
